Let \(m_3=3,m_5=5,m_7=7\).  For \(\chi\in\mathcal X\), put

\[
F_\chi(s)=\sum_{n\in\mathcal S}\frac{\chi(n)}{n^s}.
\]

The four character-twisted Euler products are, for \(\Re s>1\),

\[
F_1(s)=
\prod_{p\equiv1}\frac1{1-p^{-s}}
\prod_{p\equiv3}\frac1{1-p^{-3s}}
\prod_{p\equiv5}\frac1{1-p^{-5s}}
\prod_{p\equiv7}\frac1{1-p^{-7s}},
\]

\[
F_{\chi_{-4}}(s)=
\prod_{p\equiv1}\frac1{1-p^{-s}}
\prod_{p\equiv3}\frac1{1+p^{-3s}}
\prod_{p\equiv5}\frac1{1-p^{-5s}}
\prod_{p\equiv7}\frac1{1+p^{-7s}},
\]

\[
F_{\chi_8}(s)=
\prod_{p\equiv1}\frac1{1-p^{-s}}
\prod_{p\equiv3}\frac1{1+p^{-3s}}
\prod_{p\equiv5}\frac1{1+p^{-5s}}
\prod_{p\equiv7}\frac1{1-p^{-7s}},
\]

\[
F_{\chi_{-8}}(s)=
\prod_{p\equiv1}\frac1{1-p^{-s}}
\prod_{p\equiv3}\frac1{1-p^{-3s}}
\prod_{p\equiv5}\frac1{1+p^{-5s}}
\prod_{p\equiv7}\frac1{1+p^{-7s}},
\]

where all congruences are modulo \(8\), and products are over odd primes.

Define

\[
K=
2^{-1/4}
\bigl(L(1,\chi_{-4})L(1,\chi_8)L(1,\chi_{-8})\bigr)^{1/4}
\prod_{p\equiv3,5,7}(1-p^{-2})^{1/2}.
\]

For \(\chi\in\mathcal X\), define

\[
U_\chi=
\prod_{p\equiv3}\frac1{1-\chi(3)p^{-3}}
\prod_{p\equiv5}\frac1{1-\chi(5)p^{-5}}
\prod_{p\equiv7}\frac1{1-\chi(7)p^{-7}}.
\]

Then

\[
F_\chi(s)=\zeta(s)^{1/4}G_\chi(s),
\]

with \(G_\chi\) holomorphic and nonzero near \(s=1\), and

\[
G_\chi(1)=K U_\chi.
\]

More explicitly,

\[
G_\chi(s)=
(1-2^{-s})^{1/4}
\prod_{\eta\in\mathcal X,\eta\ne1}L(s,\eta)^{1/4}
\prod_{p\equiv3,5,7}(1-p^{-2s})^{1/2}
\prod_{a=3,5,7}\prod_{p\equiv a}
\frac1{1-\chi(a)p^{-m_as}}.
\]

Set

\[
\Omega=
\frac{\log2}{4}
+\frac14\sum_{\eta\in\mathcal X,\eta\ne1}\frac{L'}{L}(1,\eta)
+\sum_{p\equiv3,5,7}\frac{\log p}{p^2-1},
\]

and

\[
q_\chi=
-\sum_{p\equiv3}\frac{3\chi(3)\log p}{p^3-\chi(3)}
-\sum_{p\equiv5}\frac{5\chi(5)\log p}{p^5-\chi(5)}
-\sum_{p\equiv7}\frac{7\chi(7)\log p}{p^7-\chi(7)}.
\]

Thus

\[
\frac{G_\chi'}{G_\chi}(1)=\Omega+q_\chi.
\]

By Selberg-Delange, with \(\alpha=1/4\),

\[
\sum_{\substack{n\le x\\ n\in\mathcal S}}\chi(n)
=
\frac{x}{(\log x)^{3/4}}
\frac{G_\chi(1)}{\Gamma(1/4)}
\left(
1-\frac34
\frac{\frac{G_\chi'}{G_\chi}(1)+\gamma/4-1}{\log x}
+O\left(\frac1{(\log x)^2}\right)
\right).
\]

Now define

\[
\begin{aligned}
T_1&=U_1+U_{\chi_{-4}}+U_{\chi_8}+U_{\chi_{-8}},\\
T_3&=U_1-U_{\chi_{-4}}-U_{\chi_8}+U_{\chi_{-8}},\\
T_5&=U_1+U_{\chi_{-4}}-U_{\chi_8}-U_{\chi_{-8}},\\
T_7&=U_1-U_{\chi_{-4}}+U_{\chi_8}-U_{\chi_{-8}},
\end{aligned}
\]

and

\[
\begin{aligned}
R_1&=\frac{U_1q_1+U_{\chi_{-4}}q_{\chi_{-4}}+U_{\chi_8}q_{\chi_8}+U_{\chi_{-8}}q_{\chi_{-8}}}{T_1},\\
R_3&=\frac{U_1q_1-U_{\chi_{-4}}q_{\chi_{-4}}-U_{\chi_8}q_{\chi_8}+U_{\chi_{-8}}q_{\chi_{-8}}}{T_3},\\
R_5&=\frac{U_1q_1+U_{\chi_{-4}}q_{\chi_{-4}}-U_{\chi_8}q_{\chi_8}-U_{\chi_{-8}}q_{\chi_{-8}}}{T_5},\\
R_7&=\frac{U_1q_1-U_{\chi_{-4}}q_{\chi_{-4}}+U_{\chi_8}q_{\chi_8}-U_{\chi_{-8}}q_{\chi_{-8}}}{T_7}.
\end{aligned}
\]

Character inversion gives

\[
N_r(x)=\frac14\sum_{\chi\in\mathcal X}\chi(r)
\sum_{\substack{n\le x\\ n\in\mathcal S}}\chi(n).
\]

Therefore

\[
C_r=\frac{K T_r}{4\Gamma(1/4)}
\]

and

\[
D_r=-\frac34\left(\Omega+R_r+\frac{\gamma}{4}-1\right).
\]

So the requested tuple is

\[
\boxed{
\left(
\frac{KT_1}{4\Gamma(1/4)},
\frac{KT_3}{4\Gamma(1/4)},
\frac{KT_5}{4\Gamma(1/4)},
\frac{KT_7}{4\Gamma(1/4)},
-\frac34\left(\Omega+R_1+\frac\gamma4-1\right),
-\frac34\left(\Omega+R_3+\frac\gamma4-1\right),
-\frac34\left(\Omega+R_5+\frac\gamma4-1\right),
-\frac34\left(\Omega+R_7+\frac\gamma4-1\right)
\right).
}
\]

Finally, every pairwise limiting bias is

\[
\boxed{\displaystyle
\lim_{x\to\infty}\frac{N_r(x)}{N_t(x)}
=
\frac{C_r}{C_t}
=
\frac{T_r}{T_t}
\qquad(r,t\in\{1,3,5,7\}).
}
\]
